description: Extension of the CronSettings class providing helper methods related to scheduling, status display, and next run computation.

classes.name: CronSettings
classes.description: A settings class likely managing cron job configurations within the app.

methods.name: selectedJob
methods.description: Returns the currently selected CronJob based on the selectedJobId stored in store.

methods.name: statusTint
methods.description: Provides a color based on the status string, used for UI indications.

methods.name: scheduleSummary
methods.description: Generates a human-readable summary of a given CronSchedule.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a concise string.

methods.name: nextRunLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label indicating how soon the next run is scheduled.
